instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides.
2. Lower into a squat and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
3. Jump or step both feet back into a plank, keeping your body straight from head to heels.
4. Jump or step both feet back to the squat position.
5. Stand tall to finish the rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced in the plank so your hips do not sag.
2. Land softly on the balls of your feet to protect your knees.
3. Keep your knees tracking over your toes during the squat.
4. Exhale as you stand up.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms reaching forward, palms down.
2. Bend your right knee to bring your heel toward your buttocks.
3. At the same time, pull both elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
4. Return to the start and switch to the left leg.
5. Keep alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest tall and avoid leaning forward.
2. Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end of each pull.
3. Drive each heel high to fully engage the hamstrings.
4. Exhale as you pull your elbows back.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides.
2. Jog in place, kicking your right heel up toward your buttocks.
3. Switch quickly, kicking your left heel up toward your buttocks.
4. Keep your knees pointing down and swing your arms naturally.
5. Continue alternating heels at a quick pace.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
2. Brace your core for balance and stability.
3. Use quick, light foot contacts to fire the hamstrings.
4. Stay on the balls of your feet.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides.
2. Slowly lift your right heel up toward your buttocks.
3. Lower it and slowly lift your left heel toward your buttocks.
4. Keep your knees pointing down and your movements controlled.
5. Continue alternating heels at a steady, slow pace.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
2. Brace your core for balance and stability.
3. Control each heel lift to feel the hamstrings work.
4. Move with control rather than speed.

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet pressed together and your knees out to the sides.
2. Hold your feet with both hands and sit up tall.
3. Gently lower both knees toward the floor.
4. Raise both knees back up in a smooth flapping motion.
5. Continue the controlled up and down motion.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back straight and avoid slouching.
2. Breathe steadily and evenly throughout.
3. Use gentle, controlled motion to protect the hip joints.
4. Do not force the knees down past a comfortable range.
